scripts.studio:dev: npm run packages:build && npm run dev --workspace @airalogy/masterbrain-studio
scripts.studio:build: npm run packages:build && npm run build --workspace @airalogy/masterbrain-studio
scripts.packages:build: npm run build --workspace @airalogy/masterbrain-client && npm run build --workspace @airalogy/masterbrain-vue
scripts.packages:test: npm run packages:build && npm run test --workspace @airalogy/masterbrain-client && npm run test --workspace @airalogy/masterbrain-vue
scripts.packages:type-check: npm run build --workspace @airalogy/masterbrain-client && npm run type-check --workspace @airalogy/masterbrain-client && npm run type-check --workspace @airalogy/masterbrain-vue
scripts.contract:generate: cd packages/masterbrain && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-sync python ../../scripts/export_code_edit_contract.py
scripts.contract:check: cd packages/masterbrain && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --no-sync python ../../scripts/export_code_edit_contract.py --check
scripts.release:packages: npm run contract:check && npm run packages:test && changeset publish
scripts.test:python: cd packages/masterbrain && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run python -m pytest tests/test_packaging/test_desktop_packaging.py tests/test_providers/test_litellm.py tests/test_utils/test_llm.py tests/test_endpoints/test_chat/test_field_input/test_types.py tests/test_endpoints/test_chat/test_field_input/test_slot_service.py tests/test_endpoints/test_paper_generation/test_types.py tests/test_endpoints/test_protocol_debug/test_types.py tests/test_endpoints/test_code_edit/test_logic.py tests/test_endpoints/test_code_edit/test_router.py tests/test_endpoints/test_library/test_router.py tests/test_endpoints/test_workspace/test_router.py tests/test_endpoints/test_workspace/test_workspace_manager.py
scripts.test:python:all: cd packages/masterbrain && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run python -m pytest
scripts.test:studio: npm run packages:build && npm run type-check --workspace @airalogy/masterbrain-studio
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run packages:test && npm run test:studio
